title: Mailing Address Amendments, Cardinal Financial Responsibility Filing: Desk Reference
content:
## Subject

An address amendment reports to the ordering state the household's new mailing address on a Cardinal Financial Responsibility Filing certificate whose amendment rules require address amendments. The amended certificate carries the new mailing address in place of the one printed before.

The address amendment charge is the amount booked for it, once per address amendment, on its transmission. A move on a certificate whose amendment rules do not require address amendments needs no amendment and carries no charge.

## Condition on the filing's record

An address amendment charge is not fixed until every vehicle endorsement recorded on the certified policy within the past month carries its vehicle amendment on the filing's record wherever the certificate lists vehicles.

Restated: on a certificate that lists vehicles, as long as a vehicle endorsement recorded on the certified policy within the past month has no vehicle amendment of its own on the filing's record, the address amendment charge is not fixed. On a certificate that does not list vehicles the condition has nothing to wait on.

## What the address amendment records

- one amendment entry on the filing's record with the reason address change;
- one amendment transmission to the ordering state under a new transmission confirmation number;
- one filing charge with the reason amended filing on that transmission, in the amount given.

The filing's status does not change. The customer sees the amendment and its charge on the filing history.

## Invocation

**Tool:** `amend_certificate_address_1c393d15` — an agent-side tool; the representative unlocks it and then calls it.

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `filing_id` | The filing reference number of the certificate being amended, as returned by the filing lookup for the household | Identifier |
| `address_amendment_charge` | The address amendment charge to book | USD, non-negative, two decimal places; rounded to the cent on entry |

The tool takes no address parameter; it records the amendment against the filing and books the charge it is given, without calculating it.

### Return

A confirmation sentence naming the filing reference number, the new transmission confirmation number of the amendment (text beginning with SRT-) and the charge booked in USD with two decimal places. Receiving it means the amendment and its charge were recorded. No other return or error is defined.
